title: Kenya
subtitle: Apparel sourcing: costs and risks
meta: Edition of 17 November 2026. Series to {series}, weekly figures of the central bank to 13 November, scores of 1 November in the appendix.
excerpt: Kenya ends 2026 with the strongest external position in a decade and the weakest budget. Reserves of USD 14.6 billion and a shilling flat at 130 to the dollar for two years stand against a deficit heading for 7% of GDP, domestic interest absorbing a third of revenue and no IMF programme before the election of 10 August 2027.
